title: Randomized-base GT transfer, STNFS core with a 40,000-draw pool, survivor band strip, 7-owner LA tail, sub-cell descent integration, prime special-q missing logs, 2-SE descent inputs and H5' (rho <= 0.05): 124.220662069061269

claims.statement: For the production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target, the algorithm in proof.md returns the canonical scalar x for uniform T=[x]P0 (infinity included) with success at least 0.39 (modelled lower bound (1-2^-128) x 0.420255 - 2^-48), conditional on H1-H4 and H5' of source-core.md section 9, where H5' admits exchangeable relation-failure correlation rho <= 0.05 at every descent node and the boot (modelled success 0.5000 >= 0.50 at rho = 0, a disclosed margin). It maps the problem to GT by z=e(T,Q0) against a freshly randomized base g=e(P0,Q0)^b, converts both into the STNFS tower by the charged field map of field-map.md, computes a=log_g(z) with the GT core and returns ba mod r after checking [ba]P0=T. The core is our d605c287 core with the changes of REVISION.md (40,000-draw pool, survivor band strip, 7-owner row tail, 2-SE descent inputs, sub-cell descent integration, prime special-q missing logs, a shared-missing-set configuration bound under H5m, re-searched plan) and the two-log meter at 2^115.3115. The complete core ledger is below 2^120.897292 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000); total classical work, including all preprocessing, both logarithms, failures, the field map, pairings, sampling, verification and output, is 10 x (1001/1000) x 2^120.897292 + 2^80/2000 < 2^124.220662069061269 G1 reference units (C=2,000). Peak storage below 2^106 bytes; no advice and no amortization. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Fast run ({}, about 5 s): recomputes pool statistics, region, yield/margin, work SE and allowance, 2-SE descent inputs, band strip, ECM schedules, LA kernels/owners/prices, N/U trend, exact prices, table shape and shift coverage, residuals, success, ledger, G1 conversion and bijections. {"descent": true} (about 11 s) also reruns the descent (prime special-q missing-log nodes), node counter, repeats and missing-set tail at rho = 0, 0.025, 0.05, checks success decreasing in rho and >= 0.50 at rho = 0. {"unit_entries": [k, seed]} measures H4u at scale 2^k. {"source": name} prints a kernels_asm.b85 section.
